_about: Cross-check list ONLY. It is not seeded into the graph and gives no coordinates, bed counts or capabilities. source_note: Nagaland Chief Minister Health Insurance Scheme empanelled-hospital list (state government). Being empanelled says nothing about emergency or trauma capability.
